Every listing, claimed and matching $1,350

Every month

Pick any of these on their own. Month to month unless noted.

Local search and reviews, managed $1,200/mo
Profile posts, photos, services and Q&A kept current. Rank tracking run city by city, because a rank check from anywhere else tells you nothing. One plain review ask on every closed invoice with a direct link, and replies drafted for every review, including the bad ones. Monthly report.
Content engine $700/mo · 2 pieces
Starts with 45 minutes on the phone with you, recorded. What people get wrong, the job that went sideways, when you'd tell someone not to hire you. That conversation is why none of it reads like a machine wrote it. A piece is either a page answering a real customer question, or a suburb page with a real job in it — photos, what it cost, something true about the houses there. Four pieces, $1,200.
Website care and technical SEO $450/mo
Hosting, updates, speed, schema, indexing. New pages submitted the day they go live.
Follow-up, handled $950/mo
A missed call goes out as a text inside sixty seconds — usually the fastest money on this page, and it has nothing to do with search. Every quote followed up until it closes or dies. And every customer you invoiced a year or two ago gets a reason to call you again, each quarter; you already paid to get them once. Runs on a CRM we build for you first: every lead tracked from first call to paid invoice, $1,200 one time.
